$comment: Closed scheme enumeration for safety_classification[].scheme (internal project documentation Section 3.3, Section 3.6). Extensible by adding a value, never by editing an existing one's meaning. Kept as a standalone vocab file, distinct from the enum baked into entry-core.v1.schema.json, because scripts/validate.ts and the site's facet UI both read it directly; the schema enum and this file MUST be kept in lockstep by hand when a value is added.

schemes.name: GA4GH Safety Certification Level
schemes.description: A three-plus-one-level (GASL-1, GASL-2, GASL-3, GASL-3E), post-hoc certification scale.

schemes.name: GA4GH Runtime Safety Tier
schemes.description: A five-level (0-4), live operational risk tier governing runtime isolation.
